question:
Identify the number that does NOT belong to the following series.

34, 63, 94, 131, 172, 225
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb0ad5a5343dee915ad0c68ce6c2b6c2b95b10a37d28adf8131189123e6e2089.png] 

The difference is followed by consecutive prime number series. 

As 215 will come in place of 225 so option 4 is the correct answer.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
